scope: 核对 Fixture、DeepSeek ModelProvider、DeepSeek 只读 Tool Loop 和 Codex ExecutionAgent 的身份、计费来源、能力与降级语义。
invariants: Fixture isMock=true and billingSource=local; it cannot be used as real model quality evidence.
DeepSeek lanes use billingSource=api; they are not ChatGPT subscription quota.
Codex is kept as an ExecutionAgent lane; authMode may identify subscription login, but billingSource stays unknown because the public CLI exposes no billing proof.
The business Run/RunEvent/Artifact state machine does not change when a lane changes.
Unsupported capabilities are recorded as false/unknown or blocked; they are not silently inferred from model names.
limitations: Codex state_5.sqlite and .codex directory remain unwritable in the current environment; no new live Codex smoke was attempted.
DeepSeek actual model and cache fields are observed from a small batch, not a routing guarantee or cost estimate.
This matrix checks identity/capability semantics, not output quality.
